title: Lay out constrained flow containers
description: Add pure row, column, and stack layout contracts for millimetre, percentage, flexible, and intrinsic sizing with deterministic gaps, alignment, and typography constraints inside physical bounds.
acceptanceCriteria: Row, column, and stack resolve physical, percentage, flexible, and intrinsic child sizing deterministically
Gap and alignment values are applied in millimetres within the declared physical content region
Constrained typography uses bundled metrics and never browser viewport measurements
Impossible sizing and overflow return structured node-specific diagnostics
Changing preview zoom or viewport leaves normalized layout coordinates unchanged

steps.details: Add serializable sizing, gap, alignment, and typography constraint values to the rich node contracts with finite bounded validation.
Extend the existing scene layout seam to resolve fixed and percentage space first, intrinsic measurements next, and remaining flexible space in a documented stable order.
Constrain row, column, and stack results to the physical parent region and emit diagnostics naming the container and offending child when constraints cannot be satisfied.
Add focused contract cases for each sizing mode, mixed modes, alignment, gaps, typography, overflow, and zoom-independent normalized results.

technicalNotes: Timebox this task to one pure layout increment and its focused tests; defer editor controls and full workflow coverage.
Pure layout modules must not import React, DOM, storage, PDF, or QR APIs.
